title: CP-MLPs: A Tensor-Rank Theory of Tied and Untied MLP Blocks
abstract: arXiv:2611.13647v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transformer feed-forward blocks combine several design choices: squared activations, gating, and tied versus untied parameter sharing, whose separate contributions to expressivity remain poorly understood. We introduce CP-MLPs, a tensor framework in which each multiplicative unit contributes a rank-1 interaction with three roles: detecting an input feature, reading a value, and writing to the output. Tied gated blocks such as ReLU$^2$ force the detector and value roles to share the same direction; untied gated blocks such as ReGLU and SwiGLU let them differ. We show that this distinction yields exact, degree-wise tensor-rank separations: untied detector-value units are strictly more width-efficient for indefinite quadratic interactions and role-asymmetric monomials, while tied units are structurally matched to symmetric pure-power targets. translated_title: CP-MLPs：绑定与解绑MLP块的张量秩理论
translated_abstract: Transformer前馈块结合了多种设计选择：平方激活、门控机制，以及绑定与解绑的参数共享方式，而这些选择对表达能力的各自贡献仍知之甚少。我们提出了CP-MLPs，这是一个张量框架，其中每个乘法单元贡献一个秩-1交互，并承担三种角色：检测输入特征、读取数值以及写入输出。绑定的门控块（如ReLU$^2$）迫使检测器角色与数值角色共享同一方向；解绑的门控块（如ReGLU和SwiGLU）则允许二者不同。我们证明这一区分带来了精确的、按次数划分的张量秩分离：对于不定二次交互和角色非对称的单项目标，解绑的检测-数值单元在宽度效率上严格更优；而绑定单元在结构上则与对称纯幂次目标相匹配。因此，解绑所带来的宽度优势取决于目标函数的结构。实验表明损失……
tldr: 该论文提出CP-MLPs张量秩框架，将门控单元分解为检测、读取、写入三种角色，并严格证明：解绑门控块（如ReGLU/SwiGLU）在拟合不定二次交互和角色非对称目标时比绑定门控块（如ReLU²）具有严格的宽度效率优势，而绑定结构更匹配对称纯幂次目标，即解绑的收益取决于目标函数的结构。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CP-MLPs, a tensor-rank framework decomposing gated units into detector, value, and writer roles, and rigorously proves that untied gated blocks (e.g., ReGLU/SwiGLU) are strictly more width-efficient than tied blocks (e.g., ReLU²) for indefinite quadratic and role-asymmetric targets, while tied blocks structurally match symmetric pure-power targets—so the benefit of untying depends on the target structure.
